title: Generate analyzer artifacts for completed demo runs
description: Add demo-machine analyze <output-dir> and --latest flow that invokes video-evaluator to create review bundle, video shots, segment storyboard, OCR/transitions, segment evidence, layout safety, and review prompt artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Command writes video.shots.json, segment-storyboard artifacts, segment.evidence.json, layout-safety.report.json, review-bundle.json, and review-prompt.md; reruns are idempotent; missing output.mp4 errors clearly.
close_reason: Implemented video-evaluator adapter boundary and demo-machine analyze command that generates analyzer artifacts.

title: Add video-evaluator runtime dependency and adapter boundary
description: Add @45ck/video-evaluator as a runtime dependency and create one adapter module for analyzer calls. Use file:../video-evaluator only for local adaptation, then published semver before release.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency is in dependencies; no generated .video-evaluator pack is committed; adapter exposes analyzeDemoRun(); build/typecheck pass.
close_reason: Implemented video-evaluator adapter boundary and demo-machine analyze command that generates analyzer artifacts.

title: Adopt video-evaluator for shared demo analysis
description: Make demo-machine consume video-evaluator for reusable video evidence, visual review, and review prompts while keeping demo-specific playback and product gates local.
acceptance_criteria: demo-machine can run analyzer-backed review without rerendering; quality.json remains the top-level demo gate; duplicated generic analyzers are retired after parity.

title: Document demo analyzer workflow and quality gate
description: Update docs to explain demo-machine analyze, MCP review flow, golden frames, visual diff, and how video-evaluator artifacts feed quality.json.
acceptance_criteria: README/docs mention the analyzer workflow and quality-gate behavior; local-ready expectations are documented.

title: Replace MCP review-demo prompt with evaluator package-review-prompt
description: Keep the review-demo MCP prompt name, but generate the evidence-backed prompt using video-evaluator artifacts and demo-specific focus items.
acceptance_criteria: review-demo returns an evaluator-backed prompt with demo timeline accuracy, narration-before-action, caption readability, visual clarity, selector/action correctness, and layout safety focus; missing artifacts are handled gracefully.

title: Preserve golden-frame and visual-diff command contracts
description: Reimplement golden-frame extraction/comparison and visual diff through video-evaluator primitives once parity exists, preserving existing command names, baseline paths, and report paths.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm golden-frames*, pnpm visual-diff*, baselines/golden-frames, and output/visual-diff-report.json keep their contracts; threshold units match old behavior.

title: Integrate analyzer status into quality runner
description: Consume video-evaluator artifacts inside the deterministic demo-machine quality runner without replacing demo-specific checks.
acceptance_criteria: quality.json includes analyzer-derived checks; layout safety issues can fail; low-signal OCR and empty segment coverage warn; existing checks still run.

title: Retire duplicated generic visual analyzer code after parity
description: Remove or isolate duplicated pixelmatch/pngjs visual diff code and obsolete scripts only after adapter tests and example-suite parity pass.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicated generic visual code is removed or explicitly retained with rationale; optional peer dependencies are removed if unused; public exports are preserved or breaking changes are documented.
